MeasurementToolMetadata.Description: Neuropsychological test scores of the 19 participants of the main MEG cohort, copied unchanged from Neuropsychological_Data.csv of the Dryad release. Authors' README: 'A value of -1 indicates that a subject did not perform a test.'

forward_digits.Description: Digit span forward (release column 'ForwDigits'). -1 = test not performed.

backward_digits.Description: Digit span backward (release column 'BackDigits'). -1 = test not performed.

letter_number_sequencing.Description: Letter-number sequencing (release column 'LNS'). -1 = test not performed.

digit_symbol_coding.Description: Digit symbol coding test (release column 'Digit symbol coding_test'). -1 = test not performed.

tmt_a.Description: Trail-Making Test A (release column 'TMT-A'). -1 = test not performed.

tmt_b.Description: Trail-Making Test B (release column 'TMT-B'). -1 = test not performed.

zoo_map_plan.Description: Zoo Map test, planning (release column 'Zoo map_plan'). -1 = test not performed.

zoo_map_time.Description: Zoo Map test, time (release column 'Zoo map_time'). -1 = test not performed.
